description: P3-2 durable-runtime evaluation: one canonical staged flow (effect A -> human wait -> effect B -> optional v2 marker C) implemented twice — a PostgreSQL task-table runner and a Temporal TS workflow — and driven through the same C-T03/C-T04 fault scenarios (kill mid-stage, duplicate/out-of-order wakeups, restart at human wait, code-version upgrade with in-flight flows). Effects are recorded in a shared PostgreSQL ledger so duplicate effects are directly countable.
name: @infosec/runtime-eval
